name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Marketing Onboarding & Project Management | Funnels, Paid Ads Launches, Asana
summary: Marketing project manager who turns a funnel strategy into a launched campaign. I know every piece of the build firsthand: copy, landing pages, email and SMS automation, tracking, and paid ads, because I've built them myself at Solenzo and run them at Level Agency and Fetch & Funnel. At Wix I managed up to 25 concurrent launches on schedule at 110% of implementation targets and led onboarding teams of up to 30. I verify tracking, links, and automations before anything goes live.

experience.title: Growth & Lifecycle Marketing Lead — Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Run client onboarding from strategy to launch, building the funnel copy, landing pages, email and SMS automation, and tracking for each client myself.
Built a 20+ workflow funnel and lifecycle system: lead capture, qualification, booking with reminders, no-show recovery, onboarding nurture, and reactivation.
Verify tracking, links, and automations before launch: GA4 conversion events, Meta Pixel, and Google Ads tags through GTM, with UTM conventions enforced.
Optimized a client's Google Ads account to cut low-quality leads, then diagnosed on-site conversion as the remaining bottleneck.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Coordinated execution across internal departments on client campaigns, producing landing pages, email sequences, and conversion copy for accounts at $20K+/month in ad spend.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Built automated training and communication sequences for 15-20 partners across health, home services, and retail, retaining all but one (~94%).

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Ran client accounts end to end at a performance marketing agency, managing workflows and tasks in ClickUp and reducing handoff errors between teams.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Managed up to 25 concurrent client launches on fixed schedules, launching 25+ per month at 110% of implementation targets, and led onboarding teams of up to 30.
